title: festuca aristulata
intro: Festuca aristulata, commonly known as Mountain Fescue, is a perennial grass species native to mountainous regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, supporting the immune system and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Festuca aristulata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which exhibit antimicrobial and antitumor activities. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and potential applications of Mountain Fescue in traditional medicine.
